videos.title: Celebrity Fantasy Homes

videos.title: Cruise TV with LoveitBookit
videos.description: A one-stop shop for all things cruise, presenting the hottest destinations and the latest deals.

videos.title: Salvage Hunters
videos.description: Drew and Al buy from sellers who share their love for country house antiques. They snap up an 18th-century chest of drawers and smokers' bow chairs.

videos.title: Salvage Hunters
videos.description: Antique dealers Drew Pritchard and Viki Knott travel across the country, visiting incredible collectors who have assembled an array of unusual, rare, and historic treasures.

videos.title: The Yorkshire Auction House
videos.description: Angus helps a woman who needs money to pay for her elderly mother's care home but has no idea what's hiding in her jewellery box. Also, after a life-altering event on holiday, a couple must raise funds to make their home wheelchair-accessible.

videos.title: The Yorkshire Auction House
videos.description: Angus helps a roofer-turned-artist sell his sculptures for a small fortune. Plus, a woman is auctioning off her inherited clock collection.

videos.title: The Repair Shop
videos.description: Jay Blades and the team bring four treasured family heirlooms, and the memories they hold, back to life. First up is a unique and challenging commission for bear repair duo Amanda Middleditch and Julie Tatchell. Dolls Amy and David are the treasured possessions of 36-year-old Jess Hiles. First given to her when she was five, they have been her constant companions through thick and thin for over 30 years.

videos.title: The Repair Shop
videos.description: Janice Monty and her daughter Nicole from Merseyside are first to arrive, with a pair of tap shoes. These treasures were recently unearthed in a garage, and the ladies are hoping that cobbler Dean Westmoreland can breathe new life into them.

videos.description: Musical instrument restorer Pete Woods is pleased to meet Chris Bassett from Hertfordshire. Chris has brought in his very first musical instrument, which is desperate for some specialist attention.

videos.description: Horologist Steve is tasked with fixing up a one-of-a-kind gigantic clock. Classic car fanatic Dominic brings an incredible toy car back to life.
